sponsored.t: Relates to limiting the amounts that may be loaned to candidates or political committees
sponsored.sum: Limits the amount of money that may be loaned to candidates and political committees; provides that outstanding loans shall be included in determining the aggregate amount of contributions until such loan is repaid.

sponsored.t: Relates to the payment of public campaign financing funds
sponsored.sum: Changes the timing of the initial payment of public campaign financing funds to be no earlier than July 9th and no later than July 11th.

sponsored.t: Relates to payments made to commercial towing companies and storage lot operators
sponsored.sum: Requires commercial towing companies and storage lot operators to accept at least two major credit or debit cards; increases fines for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the rights of sexual assault survivors during the investigative process
sponsored.sum: Relates to the rights of sexual assault survivors during the investigative process; establishes a task force to study and assess sexual assault survivors' rights and services.

sponsored.t: Relates to unauthorized rental car use
sponsored.sum: Amends provisions relating to unauthorized rental car use; authorizes a rental vehicle company to regain custody of a rental vehicle which is not returned at the end of the rental agreement including repossession.

sponsored.t: Relates to special accidental death benefits paid to a deceased member's children
sponsored.sum: Increases the duration of special accidental death benefits paid to a deceased member's children.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting people from civil arrest while going to, remaining at, or returning from polling places
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain people from civil arrest while going to, remaining at, or returning from a polling place.

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic appearances for parking violations
sponsored.sum: Provides that persons charged with a parking violation shall be able to make an electronic court appearance unless a locality elects not to permit electronic appearances.

sponsored.t: Prohibits mandatory arbitration agreements in consumer and employment contracts; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits mandatory arbitration agreements in consumer and employment contracts; repeals existing provisions prohibiting mandatory arbitration clauses in certain consumer contracts.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting certain conditions or preconditions of employment
sponsored.sum: Prohibits employers from requiring certain conditions or preconditions of employment.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring children enrolled in an overnight camp, children's summer day camp, or travelling summer day camp to be vaccinated
sponsored.sum: Requires children enrolled in an overnight camp, summer day camp, or travelling summer day camp to be vaccinated against a specified list of diseases.

sponsored.t: Limits physician charges for missed appointments by patients
sponsored.sum: Relates to physician charges for missed appointments by patients; bars physicians from charging fees if a patient arrives on time for appointment but was not seen; requires written policy about missed appointments be prominently posted in patient waiting room and included in bills mailed to patients.

sponsored.t: Relates to registration requirements applicable to certain sex offenders who are transient
sponsored.sum: Provides registration requirements applicable to level three sex offenders and sexual predators who are transient.

sponsored.t: Requires employment and consumer dispute arbitrations to be submitted to neutral third party arbitrators, and establishes prohibited arbitration agreements and provisions
sponsored.sum: Requires employment and consumer dispute arbitrations to be submitted to neutral third party arbitrators; establishes prohibited arbitration agreements and provisions; requires disclosure of information by certain arbitrators.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory arbitration clauses in employment contracts
sponsored.sum: Requires specific notice of mandatory arbitration clauses in employment contracts.

sponsored.t: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and findings thereon
sponsored.sum: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and the arbitrator's findings of fact and conclusions of law.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a nonprofit news media jobs grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a nonprofit news media jobs grant program within the newspaper and broadcast media jobs program to provide grants to support certain nonprofit media organizations which increase employees.

sponsored.t: Relates to the requirements for licensure of funeral directors
sponsored.sum: Relates to the requirements for licensure of funeral directors; specifies requirements for a residency period under the direct supervision of a preceptor; sets requirements to act as a preceptor.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing for vacation of an arbitration award on the ground that the arbitrator was affiliated with a party, or has a financial interest in a party or the outcome
sponsored.sum: Requires disclosure of possible conflicts of an arbitrator; provides for the vacating of an arbitration award on the ground that the arbitrator was affiliated in any way with any party, or has a financial interest directly or indirectly in any party or in the outcome of the arbitration.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of misappropriation of payroll funds
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of misappropriation of payroll funds when a person knows that funds are designated for use as employee payroll funds or as payment of payroll taxes, and intentionally prevents the funds from being used for their designated purpose.

sponsored.t: Creates the New York electronic communications privacy act; search and seizure of electronic devices and electronic communications
sponsored.sum: Creates the New York electronic communications privacy act; requires government agents and agencies to obtain a search warrant for physical or electronic access to electronic device information.

sponsored.t: Requires colleges in the state to communicate all absentee deadlines for New York state elections
sponsored.sum: Requires colleges in the state to communicate all absentee deadlines for New York state elections to all enrolled students.

sponsored.t: Relates to notifying an insured of a rate filing increase or decrease for long term care
sponsored.sum: Relates to notifying an insured of a rate filing increase or decrease for long term care; provides such notification shall include instructions on how to submit comments on such rate filing.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting a plaintiff to recover directly against a third party defendant found to be liable in certain actions
sponsored.sum: Permits a plaintiff to recover directly against a third party defendant found to be liable to the defendant in certain actions.

sponsored.t: Relates to inspections of mufflers and exhaust systems
sponsored.sum: Requires inspections of motor vehicle mufflers and exhaust systems.

sponsored.t: Relates to complaint handling procedures for customers of public utilities
sponsored.sum: Strengthens provisions relating to complaint handling procedures by the public service commission; requires certain response times.

sponsored.t: Relates to arbitration organizations
sponsored.sum: Relates to arbitration organizations; requires private arbitration organizations involved in fifty or more consumer arbitrations per year to collect, publish at least quarterly, and make available to the public in a computer-searchable database certain information relating to such arbitrations; prohibits financial conflicts of interest.

sponsored.t: Relates to remedies for unlawful discharge or discrimination for the exercise of an employee's right to be absent from employment for jury duty
sponsored.sum: Creates, in addition to the existing sanction of criminal contempt of court, the remedies of labor law civil penalties and employee's right to bring civil action for unlawful discharge, penalty or discrimination on account of the exercise by an employee of a juror's right to be absent from employment by reason of jury service.

sponsored.t: Restricts insurers from demanding intrusive personal, financial and tax information from insureds as a standard practice in ordinary theft claims
sponsored.sum: Restricts insurers from demanding intrusive personal, financial and tax information from insureds as a standard practice in processing ordinary theft claims where no special circumstances warranting a demand for such information exists.

sponsored.t: Requires all motor vehicle insurers to file annual detailed financial and claim data statements with the superintendent of financial services
sponsored.sum: Requires all motor vehicle insurers to file annual detailed financial and claim data statements with the superintendent of financial services; provides that all such statements shall be made available to the public.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring mandatory arbitration clauses in certain consumer contracts to be printed in large font type
sponsored.sum: Requires mandatory arbitration clauses in certain consumer contracts to be printed in large font type.

sponsored.t: Clarifies that the writing requirement that is part of compulsory education includes cursive writing
sponsored.sum: Clarifies that the writing requirement that is part of compulsory education includes cursive writing.

sponsored.t: Prohibits utilities from charging customers excise tax
sponsored.sum: Prohibits utilities from charging customers excise tax; provides such tax shall be charged against and paid by the utility.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the purchase of ammunition if such purchaser failed a background check
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the purchase of ammunition if such purchaser failed a background check, is prohibited by federal law or is subject to a temporary or extreme risk protection order issued pursuant to article sixty-three-A of the civil practice law and rules.

sponsored.t: Relates to price comparisons of prices charged by energy services companies
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements for price comparisons of prices charged by energy services companies on customer bills.

sponsored.t: Relates to the veterans tuition awards program; repealer
sponsored.sum: Expands the veterans tuition awards program to allow the transfer of unused benefits to eligible immediate family members; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Relates to the administration of certain immunizations by a pharmacist or a certified nurse practitioner
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the administration of the mpox vaccine by a pharmacist or a certified nurse practitioner.

sponsored.t: Requires certain licensees to provide or make available drink drug testing devices
sponsored.sum: Requires certain licensees to provide or make available drink drug testing devices to protect consumers from drink spiking.

sponsored.t: Relates to the limitation on the number of justices of the supreme court in any judicial district
sponsored.sum: Permits the legislature to increase the number of justices of the supreme court in any judicial district up to one justice for every thirty thousand people in the district.

sponsored.t: Relates to the mandatory retirement age of judges and justices
sponsored.sum: Provides a mandatory retirement age for judges and justices.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring that members continue to reside in the district which they were elected to serve during their entire term
sponsored.sum: Requires that if a member of the legislature shall move their residence out of the senate or assembly district they were elected to serve during the time for which such member was elected they shall immediately vacate their seat in the legislature.

sponsored.t: Relates to surcharges for the installation or use of certain appliances in housing accommodations subject to rent control and rent stabilization
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the imposition of any surcharge for the installation or use of a tenant-installed appliance where the tenant pays for electric utility service, under rent control, and rent stabilization laws.

sponsored.t: Creates the state office of the utility consumer advocate
sponsored.sum: Creates the state office of the utility consumer advocate to represent interests of residential utility customers including a proposed change of rates, charges, terms and conditions of service, the adoption of rules, regulations, guidelines, orders, standards or final policy decisions.

sponsored.t: Defines "employer" for purposes of the fair credit reporting act; relates to the requesting or use for employment purposes of the consumer credit history of an applicant for employment or employee; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of consumer credit history in hiring, employment and licensing determinations.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage for punitive damages and civil penalties
sponsored.sum: Permits a liability policy to provide coverage for punitive damages, civil penalties and other non-compensatory damages.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of intoxication of the victim as a defense in sex crimes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of intoxication of the victim as a defense in sex crimes where the victim is under the influence of any drug, intoxicant, or other substance to a degree which rendered the victim temporarily incapable of appraising or controlling such person's conduct and such condition was known or reasonably should have been known to a person in the actor's situation.

sponsored.t: Requires primary care physicians to post information detailing how parents or guardians of children can subscribe to the US consumer product safety commission's e-mail subscription lists
sponsored.sum: Requires primary care physicians to post certain information detailing how parents or guardians of infants and children can subscribe to the United States consumer product safety commission's e-mail subscription lists.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of flavored smokeless tobacco within five hundred feet of a public or private elementary or secondary school
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of flavored smokeless tobacco within five hundred feet of a public or private elementary or secondary school; defines "flavored smokeless tobacco"; authorizes the commissioner to impose a civil penalty for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting agreements between employers that directly restrict the current or future employment of any employee
sponsored.sum: Prohibits agreements between employers that directly restrict the current or future employment of any employee; allows for a cause of action against employers who engage in such agreements.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting pre-payment penalties for mortgages secured by real property owned in a cooperative form of ownership
sponsored.sum: Prohibits pre-payment penalties for mortgages secured by real property owned in a cooperative form of ownership where over fifty percent of the units are shareholder occupied.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring high-sugar beverages to be labeled with a safety warning
sponsored.sum: Requires high-sugar beverages to be labeled with a safety warning stating that the beverage contains 100% or more of the FDA recommended daily intake of added sugar.

sponsored.t: Relates to communications by mercantile establishments attempting to settle civil actions deriving from larceny prosecutions
sponsored.sum: Requires certain notices in communications by mercantile establishments attempting to settle civil actions deriving from larceny prosecutions.

sponsored.t: Relates to price gouging
sponsored.sum: Relates to price gouging; imposes criminal penalties for price gouging; removes language relating to the declaration of a state of emergency; increases civil penalty; authorizes a district attorney to enforce provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to a half fare rate program in the MTA for veterans
sponsored.sum: Directs the MTA to establish a half fare rate program for veterans.

sponsored.t: Enacts the rider representation act relating to membership on the board of the metropolitan transportation authority
sponsored.sum: Provides voting membership to existing non-voting rider representatives on the MTA Board, provides for enhanced representation of MTA riders with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "patient privacy protection act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "patient privacy protection act"; prohibits ex-parte interviews of other party's treating physicians or health care providers in personal injury, medical, dental, or podiatric malpractice, or wrongful death actions.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing penalties for violations involving the use of pre-recorded phone messages by telephone solicitors
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalty for any person who violates the provision that a pre-recorded message must disconnect upon the caller hanging up the telephone.

sponsored.t: Relates to methods for cancelling contracts
sponsored.sum: Requires that a business allow a consumer to cancel a contract between the two parties using the same method that was used to enter into the contract.

sponsored.t: Relates to actions for illegal and improper practices of commercial towing companies
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a lien against personal and real property of the owner of a commercial towing company for illegal and improper practices; creates personal liability for members of an LLC and certain corporate shareholders.

sponsored.t: Relates to the publication of immunization information
sponsored.sum: Relates to the publication of immunization information; requires schools to provide immunization information to the commissioner of health; requires the department of health to make immunization information, including rates of immunization, available on its website.

sponsored.t: Relates to civil penalties on certain public utility companies, corporations or persons and the officers, agents and employees thereof
sponsored.sum: Increases civil penalties on certain combination gas and electric corporations that fail to comply with the public service law.

sponsored.t: Directs the division of housing and community renewal to study non-rental fees charged by landlords
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of housing and community renewal to study non-rental fees charged by landlords and report to the legislature.

sponsored.t: Creates an extra transfer for pay-per-ride Metrocard users
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing two automatic free transfers for riders using pay-per-ride Metrocards.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring immunization information systems to record data on the number of vaccine exemptions reported by each health care provider
sponsored.sum: Requires immunization information systems to record data on the number of vaccine exemptions reported by each health care provider.

sponsored.t: Expands health care plan contract coverage for any health care provider for one hundred twenty days after the termination of such contract
sponsored.sum: Expands health care plan contract coverage for any health care provider for one hundred twenty days after the termination of such contract.

sponsored.t: Relates to restrictive covenants between employers and employees with respect to agreements not to compete
sponsored.sum: Allows employers to request or require a prospective or current employee to execute a restrictive covenant not to engage in specified acts in competition with the employer after termination of the employment relationship as a condition of employment, continued employment, or with respect to severance pay.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "public university emergency contraception education act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "public university emergency contraception education act" requiring the commissioner of public health to establish a statewide emergency contraceptive college education and awareness program to promote public awareness in colleges and universities and to disseminate informational materials related to emergency contraception.

sponsored.t: Relates to identity theft prevention and mitigation services in the case of a security breach
sponsored.sum: Requires certain businesses to offer identity theft prevention and mitigation services in the case of a security breach; exempts businesses under financial hardship.

sponsored.t: Makes chapter 689 of the laws of 1993 permanent
sponsored.sum: Makes chapter 689 of the laws of 1993, and thus article 182 of the criminal procedure law titled alternate method of court appearance, permanent.

sponsored.t: Relates to class actions
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the restriction on class actions involving a penalty or minimum recovery; adds language expressly permitting class actions against governmental entities.

sponsored.t: Relates to shielding certain bequests from both federal and state estate taxes
sponsored.sum: Provides a presumption that credit shelter bequests be construed to set aside the maximum amount that may be shielded from both federal and state estate taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to eliminating sales tax on books assigned by a college or university professor
sponsored.sum: Includes books assigned by a college or university professor as required reading within the sales tax exemption which is in effect for textbooks.

sponsored.t: Relates to the practice of pharmacy and administration of immunizations
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a licensed pharmacist to administer flu immunizations to persons nine years of age or older.

sponsored.t: Expands which individuals qualify to be an individual's personal assistant for the purposes of consumer directed personal assistance programs
sponsored.sum: Expands which individuals qualify to be an individual's personal assistant for the purposes of consumer directed personal assistance programs to include an eligible individual's attorney-in-fact, health care proxy, or legal guardian.

sponsored.t: Extends and expands the scope of the on-demand E-hail paratransit pilot
sponsored.sum: Extends and expands the scope of the on-demand E-hail paratransit pilot to include an additional 1,200 users.

sponsored.t: Relates to exceptions from registration requirements for nonresident pharmacies in certain cases
sponsored.sum: Permits an exception from registration for nonresident pharmacies in cases of a specific patient need or a declared public health emergency under certain conditions.

sponsored.t: Relates to adjusted rents under the participation loan program
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain adjusted rents under the participation loan program; provides that rehabilitated rent control and rent stabilized units shall have adjusted rents determined in accordance with such programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to submission requirements for reports of independent medical examinations
sponsored.sum: Requires reports of independent medical examinations to be submitted by electronic filing; requires such report to additionally be mailed to the claimant unless the claimant opts out.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the enforcement of mandatory arbitration agreements clauses and joint-action waivers with respect to workplace disputes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the enforcement of mandatory arbitration agreements clauses and joint-action waivers with respect to workplace disputes; clarifies that section 7515 of the civil practice laws and rules applies retroactively to nullify pre-existing illegal mandatory arbitration clauses.

sponsored.t: Establishes the uniform debt-management services act
sponsored.sum: Provides for budget planning and debt settlement services; requires debt settlement companies to obtain a license.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the New York healthy vending act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York healthy vending act requiring a percentage of food in vending machines on state property to be healthy.

sponsored.t: Prohibits employers from requiring low-wage employees to enter into covenants not to compete and requires employers to notify potential employees of any requirement to enter into a covenant not to compete
sponsored.sum: Prohibits employers from requiring low-wage employees to enter into covenants not to compete; requires employers to notify potential employees of any requirement to enter into a covenant not to compete.

sponsored.t: Relates to long term care insurance rates
sponsored.sum: Requires long term care insurance carriers who propose to raise long term care insurance premiums to obtain prior approval of the superintendent of financial services.

sponsored.t: Authorizes reimbursement for testing for familial dysautonomia, Canavan's disease and Tay-Sachs
sponsored.sum: Provides that every policy which provides coverage for hospital, surgical or medical care or provides reimbursement for laboratory tests or diagnostic X-rays shall provide coverage for testing of familial dysautonomia, Canavan's disease and Tay-Sachs; provides that in order to maintain the confidentiality of persons tested, receipt of acknowledgement from the testing facility shall be deemed sufficient evidence of testing.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the inclusion of suicide prevention resources be provided with a warrant of eviction
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Requires the inclusion of suicide prevention resources to be provided with a warrant of eviction, including the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline and the applicable Suicide Crisis telephone number as provided by the Office of Mental Health.

sponsored.t: Relates to a tax credit for the installation of electrical outlets for charging electric cars in certain parking garages
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for the installation of electrical outlets for charging electric cars in certain parking garages owned by condominium management associations or cooperative housing corporations.

sponsored.t: Establishes program for familial dysautonomia, Canavan's and Tay-Sachs disease screening; authorizes department of health to provide grants
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of health to establish a program for familial dysautonomia, Canavan's and Tay-Sachs disease screening and counseling and to provide grants and to enter into contracts with public and non-profit private entities to assist in such program; provides that participation in such program shall be voluntary and all information shall be confidential.

sponsored.t: Relates to expediting actions involving insurance claims for damages resulting from a state disaster emergency
sponsored.sum: Expedites actions involving insurance claims for damages resulting from a state disaster emergency; sets time frames.

sponsored.t: Repeals the authority for sales of electricity and gas by entities other than electric or natural gas distribution companies; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals the authority for sales of electricity and gas by entities (ESCOs) other than electric or natural gas distribution companies.

sponsored.t: Requires persons or entities providing benefits in the event of disability to not impose onerous or unreasonable conditions for the payment of benefits thereunder
sponsored.sum: Requires persons or entities providing benefits in the event of disability to not impose "onerous or unreasonable conditions" for the payment or continued payment of benefits thereunder, and provides for the enforcement thereof including actual damages, interest and penalties, reasonable costs and attorney's fees, and in the court's discretion, exemplary damages; exempts worker's compensation and NYS disability insurance.

sponsored.t: Relates to the appointment and reporting duties of the superintendent of the state police and to the appointment of employees of the state police
sponsored.sum: Relates to the appointment and reporting duties of the superintendent of the state police and to the appointment of employees of the state police; requires the approval of certain duties of the state police by the superintendent of the state police.

sponsored.t: Relates to the criminal impersonation in the second degree and establishing a stolen valor fee
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person is guilty of criminal impersonation in the second degree when a person pretends to be a servicemember or former servicemember, or a first responder, or as having received a decoration or medal; establishes a stolen valor fee.

sponsored.t: Provides for the remote conduct of certain practices and procedures
sponsored.sum: Provides for the remote conduct of certain practices and procedures including meetings and notarizations utilizing electronic and/or audio-visual technologies.

sponsored.t: Authorizes NYC to impose a fee on motor vehicles from states which do not cooperate with the enforcement of certain traffic laws
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the imposition of a fifty dollar fee on vehicles entering NYC which are registered in states which do not cooperate with New York in the enforcement of traffic infractions through the use of photo-monitoring devices or signal monitoring systems.

sponsored.t: Relates to the statute of limitations of actions related to certain sex trafficking offenses
sponsored.sum: Extends the statute of limitations of actions related to certain sex trafficking offenses, reviving such actions otherwise barred by the existing statute of limitations; grants trial preference to such actions; exempts such actions from certain provisions requiring notice of claims.

sponsored.t: Classifies certain multiple entities as a single entity for contribution purposes and requires disclosure of the interests of the components or contributors thereof
sponsored.sum: Relates to campaign contribution limits on corporations; provides that all controlled corporations (subsidiaries) as defined by the IRS code shall be considered one corporation for the purposes of contribution limits; requires the treasurer of a political committee, other than a party committee, to identify and disclose the economic or other special interests of a majority of its contributors and/or organizers and the identity of any common employer or organizer.

sponsored.t: Relates to masked harassment
sponsored.sum: Establishes masked harassment when a person wears a mask or other face covering that intentionally hides or conceals their face for the primary purpose of menacing or threatening another person or placing another person or group of persons in reasonable fear for their physical safety.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting insurance companies from discriminating based on genetic predisposition; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits insurance companies from discriminating based on genetic predisposition including refusing to issue or renew, charging any increased rate, or restricting any length of coverage; prohibits insurers from requiring genetic testing.

sponsored.t: Establishes a mechanism to address problems created when a cooperative or condominium sponsor suspends efforts to sell apartments in the building being converted
sponsored.sum: Prohibits upon the vacancy of an unsold condominium or cooperative dwelling unit, the rental of such unit unless the original offering plan provided for such rental and a majority of the members of the condominium or cooperative agree thereto; generally requires the sale of such units.

sponsored.t: Relates to making technical corrections to ensure gender neutrality for the admission to practice law and preventing required disclosure of prior interaction with law enforcement or the criminal justice system
sponsored.sum: Relates to making technical corrections to ensure gender neutrality for the admission to practice law and preventing the character fitness questionnaire from inquiring into an applicant's prior interaction with law enforcement or the criminal justice system under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to treatment of gains from qualified opportunity zones in calculating taxable income
sponsored.sum: Relates to treatment of gains from qualified opportunity zones in calculating taxable income; removes exclusion of gains on property in qualified opportunity zones in calculation of income.

sponsored.t: Relates to attorneys' fees in actions for unlawful discriminatory practices
sponsored.sum: Permits awarding of reasonable attorneys' fees and costs in court actions for unlawful discriminatory practices pursuant to the human rights law.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to notify employees if they come into contact with other employees who have been infected with a virus that is causing a public health emergency
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to notify employees if they come into contact with other employees who have been diagnosed in relation to a disease outbreak causing a public health emergency; prohibits employers from disclosing the name of the diagnosed employee.

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting exemptions from immunizations; repealer
sponsored.sum: Limits exemptions from immunization requirements by local governments and private entities to medical exemptions; repeals religious exemptions for certain post-secondary students.

sponsored.t: Relates to the taxation of electronic cigarette cartridges
sponsored.sum: Provides for the taxation of electronic cigarette cartridges as tobacco products.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the use of gas-powered leaf and lawn blowers during certain months
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of gas-powered leaf and lawn blowers between May 1st and September 30th.

sponsored.t: Provides for the deduction of student loan interest from federal adjusted gross income
sponsored.sum: Provides for the deduction of student loan interest from federal adjusted gross income.

sponsored.t: Prohibits recurring campaign donations without affirmative consent
sponsored.sum: Prohibits recurring campaign donations without affirmative consent; provides that a candidate accepting a recurring contribution shall provide a receipt to the contributor disclosing the terms of the recurring contribution, provide all necessary information to cancel the recurring donation, and immediately cancel the recurring donation upon request.

sponsored.t: Relates to mortgage loan servicers
sponsored.sum: Provides that any person who has been injured by reason of any violation of any such rules, regulations or policies as the superintendent may promulgate may bring an action in such person's own name; assert a counterclaim; or, if an action is commenced by the mortgagee or anyone acting on its behalf, bring a third party claim, against either the mortgagee and/or the mortgage servicer to enjoin any violations thereof; authorizes damages; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the crime of computer tampering in the third degree
sponsored.sum: Adds that a person is guilty of computer tampering in the third degree when they intentionally enter or alter in any manner or destroy computer material indicating that a person did or did not receive a vaccination that is reported to the New York state immunization information system or the New York city immunization registry.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring mandatory arbitration clauses in certain consumer contracts to be disclosed to the consumer
sponsored.sum: Requires mandatory arbitration clauses in certain consumer contracts to be disclosed and explained to the consumer.

sponsored.t: Relates to offers and agreements to locate and retrieve abandoned property
sponsored.sum: Requires solicitations and agreements to locate and retrieve abandoned property to provide certain disclosures in large type on the first page of any notice or agreement.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring liability insurance for owners of firearms, rifles and shotguns
sponsored.sum: Requires liability insurance for owners of firearms, rifles and shotguns.

sponsored.t: Exempts the metropolitan transportation authority from the requirement to reimburse the state for services provided to such authority
sponsored.sum: Exempts the metropolitan transportation authority from the requirement to reimburse the state for state services provided to such authority.

sponsored.t: Relates to the amount of matchable contributions under the public campaign financing program
sponsored.sum: Provides that contributions up to the first $250 of any contribution amount shall be matchable contributions under the public campaign financing program.

sponsored.t: Relates to customers with documented need for essential electricity for medical needs
sponsored.sum: Provides that each electric corporation shall establish a unique priority phone number that shall remain in operation every day of the year for customers who have documented their need for essential electricity for medical needs; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to notification of a senior real property tax exemption
sponsored.sum: Requires a second notification to persons previously eligible for a senior real property tax exemption.

sponsored.t: Relates to the mandatory age of retirement for judges
sponsored.sum: Raises the mandatory age of retirement for judges to seventy-six, with the ability of certain judges and justices to serve under a certified appointment until the age of eighty.

sponsored.t: Relates to eliminating daylight saving time; repealer
sponsored.sum: Eliminates daylight saving time.

sponsored.t: Provides for a right of health maintenance organization enrollees to continue to receive services from a provider who disaffiliates
sponsored.sum: Extends period during which health maintenance organization enrollees may continue to receive services from a health care provider who disaffiliates from 60 or 90 days to 1 year, or in case of terminal illness, until the time of such insured's death; bars incentives which induce a provider to provide health care to an enrollee in a manner inconsistent with law.

sponsored.t: Relates to the designation of an independent consumer assistance program
sponsored.sum: Relates to the designation of an independent consumer assistance program to assist consumers with the filing of complaints and appeals, track problems, educate consumers, assist uninsured, insured, or underinsured consumers in accessing appropriate health care services, assist with enrollment and provide other health insurance assistance.

sponsored.t: Relating to notice of a tax exemption for persons with disabilities and limited incomes
sponsored.sum: Requires an assessor to send a second copy of the application and notice for a real property tax exemption to persons with disabilities and limited incomes thirty days prior to the appropriate taxable status date.

sponsored.t: Creates an educational pamphlet regarding the importance of prostate-specific antigen testing
sponsored.sum: Creates an educational pamphlet regarding the importance of prostate-specific antigen testing.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance reimbursement for cost of vaccinations
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance reimbursement for the total direct and indirect practice expenses associated with vaccinations.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the disclosure and publication of the home address or unpublished home telephone number of any active or retired judge or prosecutor
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the disclosure and publication of the home address or unpublished home telephone number of any active or retired judge or prosecutor.

sponsored.t: Requires a mandatory settlement conference in cooperative apartment unit foreclosure actions
sponsored.sum: Requires a mandatory settlement conference in cooperative apartment unit foreclosure actions; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount of allowance that trial and grand jurors are entitled to in each court of the unified court system
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of allowance that trial and grand jurors are entitled to in each court of the unified court system.

sponsored.t: Makes technical changes to provisions providing for certification for service as a retired judge of the court of appeals or a retired justice of the supreme court
sponsored.sum: Makes technical changes to provisions providing for certification for service as a retired judge of the court of appeals or a retired justice of the supreme court.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain charges to residential consumers in connection with the purchase of zero emissions credits
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain charges to residential consumers in connection with the purchase of zero emissions credits from the New York State Research and Energy Development Authority and attributed to the continued operation of the nuclear powered generating facility or facilities.

sponsored.t: Requires election for registration for organ, eye and tissue donations to be included upon certain state forms; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires that space be provided on applications for a civil service examination, claims for unemployment benefits, applications for the practice of a profession or occupation, state income tax returns, and applications to register a motor vehicle, for the applicant to register in the "donate life registry" for organ, eye and tissue donation established pursuant to section 4310 of the public health law.

sponsored.t: Requires disclosure of social media posts that are paid for by a campaign
sponsored.sum: Requires disclosure of social media posts that are paid for by a campaign; authorizes the state board of elections to promulgate certain regulations.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding service of process to the department of state in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Expands service of process to the department of state in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Expands who can hold membership in an adult-use cooperative license
sponsored.sum: Expands who can hold membership in a licensed adult-use cooperative to include persons other than natural persons.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Count Every Vote Act of New York"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Count Every Vote Act of New York" which amends the procedure for the recanvass of votes in election districts; defines margin of victory for the purpose of triggering a hand recount of ballots.

sponsored.t: Includes the display of a swastika in public view in aggravated harassment in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Relates to aggravated harassment in the first degree; includes the display of a swastika in public view in aggravated harassment in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to establish discharge plans and reentry services for wrongfully convicted individuals upon their discharge
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to establish discharge plans and reentry services for wrongfully convicted individuals upon their discharge which includes housing needs, educational needs, employment needs, medical needs, and specific social service needs.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the inclusion of a confession of judgment in a contract or agreement for a financial product or service
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the inclusion of a confession of judgment in a contract or agreement for a financial product or service.

sponsored.t: Relates to budget planning
sponsored.sum: Clarifies certain provisions relating to the prohibition on budget planning; allows the attorney general to apply for an order enjoining or restraining commission or continuance of violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to redetermination of a tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by senior citizens or persons with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Permits a redetermination of a tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by senior citizens or persons with disabilities upon a permanent decrease in income.

sponsored.t: Relates to the purchase of zero-emission buses and the procurement of electric-powered buses, vehicles or other related equipment
sponsored.sum: Relates to the purchase of zero-emission buses and the procurement of electric-powered buses, vehicles or other related equipment and infrastructure; requires public utilities to have infrastructure, capacity, facilities, and transmission and distribution systems needed to supply power for the charging of zero-emission buses and provides a tariff for charging of electric buses.

sponsored.t: Establishes the office of organized retail theft
sponsored.sum: Establishes the office of organized retail theft within the department of law to receive and investigate complaints from any source, or upon its own initiative, of allegations involving the use and role of organized retail theft.

sponsored.t: Relates to the issuance of appearance tickets for certain violations of the agriculture and markets law
sponsored.sum: Relates to the issuance of appearance tickets for certain violations of the agriculture and markets law when the person is charged with a crime for which the court may order the posting of a security.

sponsored.t: Restores medical futility as a basis for DNR
sponsored.sum: Restores medical futility as a basis for DNR.

sponsored.t: Enacts tuition-free NY to provide free tuition at SUNY, CUNY and community colleges
sponsored.sum: Makes tuition free for New York state residents at SUNY and CUNY schools and community colleges; requires state residency and employment for a period of five years after completion of academic program.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing pharmacies to store medication in automated dispensing machines
sponsored.sum: Allows pharmacies to store medication in automated dispensing machines if a contractual agreement is in place with a nursing home or healthcare facility at such facility for the residents.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing penalties for assault, obstruction and harassment of an election officer
sponsored.sum: Includes within the class D felony of assault in the second degree, the intentional causing of physical injury to an election officer while such person is performing their assigned duties; amends aggravated harassment and obstruction of governmental administration to include election officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to court ordered forensic evaluations and reports in child custody and visitation proceedings
sponsored.sum: Relates to court ordered forensic evaluations and reports in child custody and visitation proceedings.

sponsored.t: Relates to the automated storage and dispensing of controlled substances using an automated dispensing device
sponsored.sum: Relates to the automated storage and dispensing of controlled substances using an automated dispensing device at licensed nursing homes, residential health care facilities and hospices.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of environmental conservation to establish standards for inspection and certification of green roofs and provides for a green roof installation credit
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of environmental conservation to establish standards for and a program of inspection and certification of green roofs prior to and after installation, including standards for environmentally acceptable chemical fertilizers and the testing of runoff water for evidence of such fertilizers; establishes a green roof installation tax credit in the amount of fifty-five percent of qualified expenditures with a credit maximum of five thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to strategic lawsuits against public participation and makes technical corrections
sponsored.sum: Relates to strategic lawsuits against public participation; makes technical corrections; relates to the applicability of chapter 250 of the laws of 2020 amending the civil rights law relating to actions involving public petition and participation.

sponsored.t: Relates to discrimination against vaccinated persons
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination against vaccinated persons.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring memorization of multiplication tables as part of the basic education program
sponsored.sum: Requires memorization of multiplication tables as part of the basic education program in public schools.

sponsored.t: Relates to employee human trafficking recognition training
sponsored.sum: Establishes the standardized human-trafficking recognition training program for private transportation services employees; requires private transportation services to require all employees to undergo a human-trafficking recognition training program established by the division of criminal justice services and the office of temporary and disability assistance in consultation with the department of transportation and the New York state interagency task force on human trafficking.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crimes of reckless endangerment of an emergency service person in the first and second degrees
sponsored.sum: Establishes the offenses of reckless endangerment of an emergency service person in the first and second degrees.

sponsored.t: Adds assault of certain transportation workers to assault in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Adds assault of a highway worker, motor vehicle investigator and motor vehicle inspector to the crime of assault in the second degree; defines such terms.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "mandatory arbitration & business licensing act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "mandatory arbitration & business licensing act"; provides that no state agency or local government shall issue or renew a covered license to any person that refuses to certify that such person will not, as the owner or operator of a business or provider of services in the state or a local government operating pursuant to such license; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the  civil justice protection act (CJPA)
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "civil justice protection act (CJPA)"; requires that no person shall waive a series of rights and procedures when purchasing goods and services.

sponsored.t: Creates the state office of the utility consumer advocate
sponsored.sum: Creates the state office of the utility consumer advocate to represent interests of residential utility customers including a proposed change of rates, charges, terms and conditions of service, the adoption of rules, regulations, guidelines, orders, standards or final policy decisions.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 60 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bills: Assembly Bill Number 33, entitled: "AN ACT in relation to establishing the task force to promote the employment of people with disabilities" Assembly Bill Number 468, entitled: "AN ACT directing the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study of official inspection stations, safety inspections and fees" Assembly Bill Number 1988-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to establishing a center for technical assistance relating to age-friendly health systems; and in relation to hospital performance data" Assembly Bill Number 2468, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public service law, in relation to creating the state office of the utility consumer advocate" Assembly Bill Number 2497, entitled: "AN ACT establishing a fiscal cliff task force to conduct a…

sponsored.t: Relates to the conditional examination of seniors before trial and a senior's participation in grand jury proceedings
sponsored.sum: Allows for the conditional examination of victims who are at least 75 years of age; amends the definition of larceny to ensure that alleged consent by a victim who is mentally disabled is a not a defense to larceny; permits a caregiver to accompany a vulnerable victim into the grand jury.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting a plaintiff to recover directly against a third party defendant found to be liable in certain actions
sponsored.sum: Permits a plaintiff to recover directly against a third party defendant found to be liable to the defendant in certain actions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the veterans tuition awards program
sponsored.sum: Expands the veterans tuition awards program to allow the transfer of unused benefits to a spouse, survivor or child; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of consumer credit history for certain purposes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of consumer credit history in hiring, employment and licensing determinations.

sponsored.t: Requires comparison of prices charged by energy services companies
sponsored.sum: Requires that a billing statement delivered to the customer by an energy services company include a side-by-side comparison showing both the price charged by the energy service company for commodity and delivery service during the prior billing period, and the price the customer would have paid had they taken commodity and delivery service from their local utility corporation or municipality; requires an energy service company to provide each of its customers with an annual statement comparing the price charged by the energy service company for commodity and delivery services and other energy-related value-added products over the prior twelve-month period with the price such customer would…

sponsored.t: Relates to including rifles and shotguns in warnings to consumers regarding the risk of death or suicide
sponsored.sum: Includes rifles and shotguns in required warnings to consumers regarding the risk of death or suicide in homes where such weapons are present.

sponsored.t: Relates to the climate change adaptation cost recovery program and requirements for climate change adaptive infrastructure projects
sponsored.sum: Relates to the climate change adaptation cost recovery program and requirements for climate change adaptive infrastructure projects; relates to the use of funds from the climate change adaptation fund for certain projects; relates to the disclosure of certain data from returns of petroleum or fossil fuel businesses; relates to expenditure of funds from the climate change adaptation fund; repeals certain provisions; relates to severability and legislative findings.
